finding: We tested whether pooling visible endpoint artifacts hides opposing errors in local-goal probabilities. At 2,048 labels, endpoint pooling hides up to 0.23066 percentage points of absolute calibration discrepancy in the predictive bank under native weighting. Independent reconstruction, all 2,196 paired estimates and both complete replays verify this constructed-method diagnostic. No practical-impact threshold was specified; historical goal correspondence and human intent remain unestablished.
